# Phase 2 — UI Design Contract

> Visual and interaction contract for frontend phases. Generated by gsd-ui-researcher, verified by gsd-ui-checker.

**Auto-generated (non-interactive `--auto` run).** No AskUserQuestion prompts were issued. Every value below is either (a) inherited unchanged from Phase 1's approved `01-UI-SPEC.md` and the live codebase (`components.json`, `app/globals.css`, `lib/hooks/*`), or (b) a best-judgment default derived from `02-CONTEXT.md`, `REQUIREMENTS.md`, and `CLAUDE.md`, explicitly marked **[ASSUMPTION]** where genuinely new. Nothing here contradicts a locked CONTEXT.md decision.

---

## Design System

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Tool | shadcn/ui — already initialized (Phase 1); no re-init needed |
| Preset | `b2fA` — style: `nova`, base: `radix`, baseColor: `neutral`, font: `geist`, iconLibrary: `lucide` (per `npx shadcn info`, verified live 2026-07-23) |
| Component library | Radix UI primitives (via shadcn) |
| Icon library | `lucide-react` — `Fingerprint` already reserved for this tool in `tools/registry.ts`; `Copy`, `Check`, `RefreshCw`, `Download` for this phase's new controls |
| Font | Geist Sans (UI/body) + Geist Mono (copyable technical values) — inherited unchanged from Phase 1's `next/font`/`geist` setup in `app/layout.tsx` |
| Keyboard `/` target **[ASSUMPTION, resolves CONTEXT.md's flagged open item]** | Focuses the batch-count `Input` — the only free-value entry field on this page (see rationale below) |

**Rationale for the `/` target:** CONTEXT.md explicitly left this undecided ("no traditional search input exists for a default-on-load UUID generator... pick a sensible target and document the choice"). The batch-count number input is the single free-value field on the page; every other control is a fixed-cardinality toggle/segmented control. Binding `/` there gives keyboard users a consistent "the site's search-like shortcut always focuses this page's one adjustable input" mental model, and is a strict no-op-if-absent per the existing hook's unbound-safe design (Phase 1 `useKeyboardShortcut`) — no risk if a later redesign removes the input. `Enter` still regenerates page-wide (D-03), independent of this binding.

**New shadcn components required this phase** (all official registry, none yet in `components/ui/`): `select` or `toggle-group` (version + export-format segmented controls — recommend `toggle-group` for single-click, no-dropdown selection consistent with "zero-effort instant result"), `switch` (case/hyphens toggles), `input` (batch count), `label`, `scroll-area` (batch list, D-05). Reused unchanged from Phase 1: `button`, `card`, `badge`, `separator`, `tooltip`, plus `lib/hooks/useCopyToClipboard.ts` and `lib/hooks/useKeyboardShortcut.ts`.

## Spacing Scale

Declared values (must be multiples of 4) — inherited unchanged from Phase 1:

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| xs | 4px | Icon gaps, inline padding |
| sm | 8px | Compact element spacing (toggle/switch groups) |
| md | 16px | Default element spacing (form-row gaps) |
| lg | 24px | Section padding (worked-example, FAQ blocks) |
| xl | 32px | Layout gaps (between hero result and controls panel) |
| 2xl | 48px | Major section breaks (result section → worked example → FAQ) |
| 3xl | 64px | Page-level spacing (top/bottom page padding, matches `app/page.tsx`'s `py-12`) |

Exceptions:
- Icon-only interactive controls (copy buttons, regenerate button, mobile-adjacent controls) keep the Phase 1 minimum 44×44px hit area via padding around a smaller visual icon (16–20px), never by breaking the 4px grid.
- Batch-list scroll container max-height uses `max-h-96` (384px) — already a multiple of 4, no exception needed; documented here only so the executor doesn't invent an arbitrary value.

## Typography

Inherited unchanged from Phase 1 — same 4 declared sizes/weights, reused for this phase's content:

| Role | Size | Weight | Line Height |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| Label | 14px | 600 (semibold) | 1.4 |
| Body | 16px | 400 (regular) | 1.5 |
| Heading | 20px | 600 (semibold) | 1.2 |
| Display | 32px | 600 (semibold) | 1.2 |

Phase 2 role assignments:
- **Display** — page `h1` only ("UUID Generator"), one per page.
- **Heading** — the primary single-UUID hero value (batch count = 1); section headings ("How it works", "Worked example", "FAQ").
- **Body** — batch-list rows (batch count 2–100); worked-example prose; FAQ answers; page intro paragraph.
- **Label** — form-control labels ("Version", "Case", "Hyphens", "Batch count", "Export format"), FAQ question text, copy-button `aria-label`/visible captions.

**Monospace override** (extends Phase 1's rule from the visitor-IP value to UUIDs, as anticipated in `01-UI-SPEC.md`): Geist Mono replaces Geist Sans, at the same size/weight as the role it appears in, for every UUID value on this page —
- Hero single value: Heading size/weight (20px/600) in Geist Mono.
- Batch-list rows: Body size/weight (16px/400) in Geist Mono.
- Worked-example sample v4/v7 values: Body size (16px/400) in Geist Mono.

## Color

60/30/10 split — inherited unchanged from Phase 1 (values confirmed live in `app/globals.css`, both themes):

| Role | Light | Dark | Usage |
|------|-------|------|-------|
| Dominant (60%) | `#FFFFFF` white | `#020617` slate-950 | Page background |
| Secondary (30%) | `#F1F5F9` slate-100 | `#0F172A` slate-900 | Result card, controls-panel card, FAQ accordion surface |
| Accent (10%) | `#0891B2` cyan-600 | `#22D3EE` cyan-400 | See reserved list below |
| Destructive | `#DC2626` red-600 | `#EF4444` red-500 | Reserved — no destructive actions exist in Phase 2 |

Accent reserved for (explicit list — never "all interactive elements"):
- Copy-button icon default/hover/active state + "Copied!" flash, for every copy action on this page (single-UUID copy, Copy All, per-row copy if offered)
- Regenerate button/icon (the page's core repeatable action, per D-03)
- Active/selected state of the version (v4/v7) and export-format segmented controls — a tint or underline on the currently selected option only, not the whole control
- Keyboard focus ring (all interactive elements — inherited global rule)

Deliberately kept neutral (outline/ghost button styling, not accent), to avoid accent overuse:
- Download button — secondary to copy per the brief's "one-click copy everywhere" core value; copy is the primary interaction, download is a bonus path
- Case/hyphens `Switch` toggles — use the switch component's own on/off track styling (part of the shadcn primitive), not a page-level accent override
- FAQ accordion triggers, worked-example card border

Destructive is reserved and unused this phase — consistent with Phase 1: regenerating/reformatting values is instant and fully reversible (D-02/D-03), nothing is destroyed or persisted to lose, so no confirmation pattern is needed yet.

## Copywriting Contract

| Element | Copy |
|---------|------|
| Primary CTA | "Copy UUID" — icon+label button on the hero single value (batch count = 1); swaps to "Copied!" for ~2s on activation, mirroring `IpBadge`'s exact pattern (icon+label swap, `aria-live="polite"` announcement, never color-alone) |
| Secondary CTA — batch mode | "Copy all" — copies every visible batch value per the D-07 format selector (plain text/CSV/JSON), same swap-to-"Copied!" pattern |
| Secondary CTA — regenerate | "Regenerate" — icon button (e.g. `RefreshCw`) always visible near the result; also triggered by the global `Enter` shortcut (D-03) |
| Secondary CTA — export | "Download" — downloads the current result in the D-07 selected format; filename pattern `uuids.txt` / `uuids.csv` / `uuids.json` **[ASSUMPTION — no filename convention was specified; plain, predictable, extension-matched name]** |
| Empty state heading/body | Not applicable — batch count is clamped to 1–100 and generation is synchronous client-side (`uuid` package); no "zero results" state is reachable in production, same reasoning as Phase 1's tool-registry grid |
| Error state — copy failure | "Couldn't copy — select the text and copy manually." Shown inline in place of the "Copied!" confirmation when `useCopyToClipboard`'s existing `error` flag is set; never a popup/toast |
| Error state — batch-count out of range | "Enter a number between 1 and 100." Shown inline below the batch-count input only while the raw typed value is outside 1–100 (including non-numeric/decimal/negative); the underlying generated batch stays clamped to the last valid value, so generation is never blocked on this validation message |
| Destructive confirmation | None in Phase 2 — no destructive actions exist; regenerating/reformatting is instant and reversible, consistent with Phase 1 |

## UI Considerations

> Populated by the ui-phase UI-consideration probe (Step 9.5) and lifted by plan-phase's
> `## UI Considerations` lift rule via the identical rule as SPEC `## Edge Coverage`. Shape-rooted UI *state*
> coverage (empty / loading / error / populated / partial / overflow / zero-one-many / long-text).
> Empty-state and error-state COPY live in `## Copywriting Contract` above — this section covers
> state coverage and REFERENCES those rows rather than restating the copy (de-dup).

Applicable state considerations resolved: 13 covered, 3 backstop, 0 unresolved

| Category | Element(s) | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | uuid-hero-display (interactive-control) | ✅ covered | Page always renders a generated v4 UUID on load with zero required input (UUID-01); generation is synchronous client-side (`uuid` package + Web Crypto) and cannot return "no result," so no empty-state UI exists. |
| loading | uuid-hero-display (interactive-control) | ✅ covered | Value is generated during the initial client render via a lazy `useState` initializer (not an effect) — avoids a flash of empty/placeholder content and the hydration-mismatch flicker named in Success Criterion 1. |
| error | uuid-hero-display (interactive-control) | ✅ covered | UUID generation cannot fail (no network call, no invalid input) — no error state is possible for the value itself; see the separate "copy failed" row below for the one real failure mode on this page. |
| populated | uuid-hero-display (interactive-control) | ✅ covered | Default view (batch count = 1) renders the single hero value in Heading-size Geist Mono; switching version (D-01) or toggling case/hyphens (D-02) updates this same element in place, no new element mounted. |
| partial | uuid-hero-display (interactive-control) | ✅ covered | A UUID is generated atomically — there is no reachable "half-generated" runtime state. |
| long-text | uuid-hero-display (interactive-control) | 🧪 backstop | The 36-char hyphenated value (32 unhyphenated) must never truncate/clip — wraps or reduces type size at ≤320px rather than clipping, same backstop pattern as Phase 1's IPv6 value. Needs a visual test at 320px with hyphens both on and off. |
| zero-one-many | hero-vs-list switch (batch count) | ✅ covered | Batch count = 1 shows the single hero display (row above); count 2–100 switches to the scrollable list (D-05, row below) — one deterministic branch point at count=2, not three separate ad-hoc visual treatments. |
| overflow | batch-uuid-list (list-collection) | 🧪 backstop | Batch results (2–100 values) render as a single scrollable list, one UUID per line, same treatment regardless of size (D-05) — uses a `max-h-96` scroll container so a 100-row batch never pushes page-level layout/CLS. Needs a visual test at count=100. |
| long-text | batch-uuid-list (list-collection) | 🧪 backstop | Same 36-char wrap-not-clip rule as the hero value applies to every row. Needs a visual test at 320px with a full 100-row batch. |
| empty | batch-uuid-list (list-collection) | ✅ covered | Batch-count input is clamped to 1–100 (see error row below) — a batch of 0 rows can never be requested, so no empty-list state is reachable. |
| loading / error | batch-uuid-list (list-collection) | ✅ covered | Same reasoning as the hero-display loading/error rows: synchronous client-side generation, no network — no spinner or error state exists for the list itself. |
| error | batch-count-input (interactive-control) | ✅ covered | Values outside 1–100 (non-numeric, decimal, negative, >100) show the inline hint "Enter a number between 1 and 100" (Copywriting Contract) with no popup/reload; the generated batch stays clamped to the last valid value. |
| error | copy-actions (interactive-control — single copy, copy-all) | ✅ covered | `useCopyToClipboard`'s existing `error` flag (Phase 1, reused unchanged) surfaces a rejected clipboard write as the inline "Couldn't copy — select the text and copy manually" message instead of a silent failure. |
| populated | version-toggle / case-toggle / hyphen-toggle / export-format-toggle (interactive-controls) | ✅ covered | All four are fixed-cardinality controls (2 or 3 options each) — always fully populated; no empty/loading/error/partial state can occur for a static option set. |
| overflow / long-text | worked-example, faq (static-content) | ✅ covered | Both sections are static build-time copy (D-09–D-11) with no user-generated or variable-length input — standard prose wrap, no truncation risk. |
